scientific_integrity: The proof separates diagonal-interior and endpoint-corner contributions and explicitly credits the pure-power predecessor. A deterministic checker verifies normalization bridges and threshold exponents; it is not used as a substitute for the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: First-order lower-tail asymptotics only; no second-order remainder or general closed form for \(J_m\) is claimed. Royen (2008) already proves the one-sided pure-power threshold and critical logarithm, so originality is restricted to the exact two-sided Beta localization and constants for \(n=3\).
title: Exact lower-tail phase diagram for the three-sample Beta variance
